newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones says takeover report 'nonsense'.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones says takeover report 'nonsense'.

text.p: Dow Jones & Co Inc said on Friday a Business Week report that Reuters Holdings Plc has expressed interest in buying, merging or forming a joint venture with Dow Jones is "nonsense."
"This report is nonsense," Dow Jones spokesman Roger May said.
Earlier May had called the article "pure speculation" and cited the company's standard policy of not commenting on market rumors.
But he said that given the day's activity in Dow Jones's stock he was making the additional comment on the story.
"Obviously there is a lot of activity going on today (in Dow Jones shares) and it's obviously in response to the Business Week article," he said.
Shares in Dow Jones were up 2-1/2 at 41. Reuters were down two to 62-3/4 in Nasdaq trading.
A Reuters spokesman earlier declined comment on the report, saying the company "never addresses speculation or rumor of this sort."
In its February 10 issue released on Thursday, Business Week said Reuters had approached some of the controlling shareholders of Dow Jones expressing interest in making a deal.
